[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Dish Name: Smoothie Bowl  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Ingredients for Smoothie Bowl:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Frozen berries (1 cup)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Banana (1)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Greek yogurt (1/2 cup)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Milk (1/2 cup)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Honey (1 tbsp)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Chia seeds (1 tbsp)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Granola (1/4 cup)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Fresh fruit (1/2 cup)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Preparation time for Smoothie Bowl: 5 min  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Calories for Smoothie Bowl: approximately 300  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Preparation Instructions for Smoothie Bowl:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. In a blender, combine frozen berries, banana, Greek yogurt, milk, honey, and chia seeds. Blend until smooth.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Pour the smoothie mixture into a bowl.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Top with granola and fresh fruit.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Serve immediately and enjoy!  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Dish Name: Avocado Toast  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Ingredients for Avocado Toast:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Avocado (1)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Whole wheat bread (2 slices)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Salt (to taste)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Black pepper (to taste)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Lemon juice (1 tsp)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Preparation time for Avocado Toast: 5 min  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Calories for Avocado Toast: approximately 300  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Preparation Instructions for Avocado Toast:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit. Mash the avocado in a bowl.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Toast the bread slices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Spread the mashed avocado on top of the toasted bread slices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Sprinkle salt, black pepper, and lemon juice
